newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at second highest close ever.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at second highest close ever.

text.p: Britain's leading share index powered higher on Tuesday as investors stared down a possible interest rate hike and focused on bullish corporate earnings.

The FTSE 100 jumped 64.9 points or 1.3 percent to 4,960.6, its second highest closing price ever and near its all-time best of 4,998.1. Shares in pharmaceuticals and oil companies, led by British Petroleum , contributed about 33 points to the index.
The FTSE 250 of second-tier companies gained 13.6 points or 0.3 percent to 4,498.6.
